A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their text, equations, figures, table and appendices A–J are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v2 reports original measurements of language-model representation geometry, linguistic probing and downstream classification in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including layerwise intrinsic-dimension measurements, representation comparisons, probing accuracies and transfer experiments.

M1.justification: The models, last-token representations, GRIDE estimator, Information Imbalance measure and probing procedures are unchanged. Expanded explanations do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use Bookcorpus, the Pile, WikiText-103, the same linguistic probing tasks, IMDb sentiment and Jigsaw toxicity data, including existing shuffled controls. Brain encoding is mentioned only as a potential application.

E2.justification: Section 3.5 retains the same alternative similarity measures, Appendix H retains the CKA comparisons, and Appendix I retains shuffled-label baselines. Newly cited works are not added experimental comparators.

E3.justification: Section 3.2 clarifies the existing five nonoverlapping 10k partitions as 50k sampled sequences divided into 10k partitions. Removing the 'zero-shot' label does not alter classifier training already documented in v2. Table C.1 and Appendix I/J settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Scale sensitivity, model-size checks, information-plane analysis and shuffled-label controls are retained. The added Appendix E paragraph repeats the interpretation already present in v2's Figure E.2 caption rather than adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Five corpus partitions, five-seed probing and transfer experiments, standard-deviation bars and Spearman correlation tests remain unchanged. No additional runs or uncertainty-reporting procedures are introduced.

E6.justification: All main and appendix plots retain their results, with no added or removed result entries. Figure 6 still reports Spearman correlations of -0.46 (p = 0.09) and 0.65 (p = 0.01).

T1.justification: The GRIDE likelihood, stated estimation assumptions, peak definition and Information Imbalance equation are retained. The added TwoNN comparison and explicit estimator notation explain existing mathematics without introducing a new derivation or proof.

C1.justification: Section 5 removes the explicit 'first study of its kind' novelty assertion. The abstract and central claims about the high-dimensional abstraction phase, cross-model similarity and language-processing performance remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix C.2 adds lowercasing to the proposed explanation for Bookcorpus's lower ID peaks, and Section 5 adds brain encoding as a potential application. The causal-evidence limitation remains; Appendix E's expanded interpretation already appeared in the earlier caption.

D1.justification: Section 6 replaces promised public release with an explicit repository link for corpora, code and a README, also displayed below the abstract. Section 3.2 clarifies sampling without replacement and corpus-wide token shuffling, without establishing changed experiments.

R1.justification: v3 adds Yin et al. on local ID and truthfulness, Sucholutsky et al. and Williams on representation comparison, and Antonello and Cheng on brain representations. These modestly broaden positioning, alongside removal of the first-of-its-kind assertion.

P1.justification: v3 clarifies sampling and GRIDE explanations, removes the 'zero-shot' wording, trims the conclusion and repeats caption material in Appendix E prose. It adds acknowledgments and updates publication headers while retaining the overall organization.

P2.justification: All 19 figures and Table C.1 are retained. Appendix figures are repositioned, captions and spacing receive limited edits, and citations and URLs gain colored hyperlink styling; the plotted content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 improves clarity through sampling explanations and correction of the 'zero-shot' description, provides an explicit code/data access link, and updates relevant literature. These are useful documentation and positioning improvements, while the empirical evidence and acknowledged need for causal validation remain unchanged.
